pkgmetadata.longdescription: Agent WeChat is a native WeChat client and local daemon with a command line interface and an authenticated HTTP API. It connects to WeChat directly, can reuse an existing WeChat for Linux profile, and lets scripts or AI agents read conversations, send messages and work with media.
Agent WeChat 是原生微信客户端和本地守护进程，提供命令行界面与带认证的 HTTP API。它直接连接微信服务器，可复用现有的微信 Linux 版数据目录，让脚本 或 AI agent 读取会话、发送消息并处理媒体文件。
